summary: Full E2E testing for Susan Tumuhairwe brand site. Backend inquiries API (POST/GET) passes all 5 pytest cases including 422 for invalid email. Frontend home crossroad cards navigate correctly, all 4 nav-links present and route properly, Speaking booking form shows error toast on empty submit, submits successfully with valid data, shows success toast, clears form, and persists inquiry to MongoDB (verified via GET /api/inquiries).

issues: Preferred date uses native browser date picker (<input type=date>) instead of shadcn Calendar component - inconsistent with premium design system

action_items: (Optional/design) Replace native date input with shadcn Calendar+Popover in Speaking booking form for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: created_at stored as ISO string - fine but inconsistent with StatusCheck which stores datetime; consider standardizing.

Navbar nav-link click via Playwright failed with 'element outside viewport' on inner pages when scrolled - underlying header uses transform on scroll; not user-visible but flag if e2e stability matters. Works via direct anchor/JS click.
InquiryCreate has no length limits on message/name/etc - consider adding max_length constraints to prevent large payloads.
GET /api/inquiries exposes all data publicly with no auth - acceptable for MVP but should be admin-gated for production.
seed_data_creation: One test inquiry created: email playwright@example.com, name TEST_Playwright User. Plus 1 backend test inquiry TEST_Jane Doe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints POST/GET /api/inquiries verified. Playwright submission validated end-to-end. If retesting nav clicks with Playwright on non-home pages, click via page.evaluate JS or set viewport to have header in view - direct .click() sometimes reports element-outside-viewport due to fixed header animations.
